items.title: ARTEX in the Wild: Storm-0940 Expands Targeting of IT and Software Vendors
items.summary: Wiz Research is tracking an ARTEX-using actor, overlapping with Storm-0940, across multiple targeted software vendors. Learn how the AI agent attacks Okta, Entra, and Cognito, and what it left behind in the logs.
items.creator: Sapir Federovsky
